summary: All 8 integration milestone assertions passed. Shell assertions (VAL-SETUP-007 build, VAL-CROSS-007 Tauri build) both verified. Cross-area browser assertions confirmed: complete user flow (profile→template→copy), full promotion workflow, profile data flows into templates and signatures, theme persistence across pages, and XSS prevention. VAL-CROSS-003 verified via code analysis that employee signature logic correctly selects company email for management and store email for staff, though the live preview only shows store-level info (individual signatures are added during EML download). VAL-CROSS-007 Tauri build completed in 30.62s producing an 11.2 MB release binary.
